To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the students' selection of a higher education department is influenced by different criteria and sub-criteria depending on the geographical region of the educational institution.
students from the central region of Greece are more affected by financial factors and students from the peripheral regions are more affected by personal factors.

'family income' is the most important criterion in selecting a department in a central higher education institute while 'life quality' is the most influential in selecting a department at a peripheral institution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the factors that affect the selection of a department of accounting and finance in higher educational institute.
the students' selection of an accounting and finance department and the factors that affect this decision.
the students' decision making process in choosing their department and university and the factors that influence their choices.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the students' choice is influenced by both 'personal and financial factors'.
the students' choice of the department of accounting and finance is determined by the combination of 'financial factors' and 'personal factors'.
the selection criteria of a higher educational institution' department are not the same for all students and they depend on a number of personal, social and environmental factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
students' selection criteria are not the same in the two groups.
the students' choice of the accounting and finance department is affected by a number of factors.
the ranking of the students' department choice criteria is different in the two investigated groups of students and this is mainly due to the geographical position of the higher education institutes.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the selection of a department of a higher educational institution is affected by a variety of criteria, some of which may not be directly linked to the department itself.
students from different educational institutions are affected by different factors when making their department selection.
the selection process of an accounting and finance undergraduate degree is not the same for students in different parts of the country.
